items.name: Vetusta Bell Cloak
items.lore: Abbey white, with the bell. Given to those who took Vetusta back.

items.name: Cloister Key Ring
items.lore: The cloister key, hammered into a ring. The doors have new locks now.

items.name: White Cord Belt
items.lore: A true brother's cord, given in thanks.

items.name: Abbey Wall Bracer
items.lore: Banded iron from the abbey gate, rebuilt.

items.name: Hrodric's Red Cord
items.lore: Won from Brother-Captain Hrodric, the Bishop's Sword. The Faithful cut it in two.

items.name: Red Abbot's Cope-Clasp
items.lore: Won from the Red Abbot when Vetusta held. Burhoff's own clasp.

draughts: Gwladys's own. Bitter, and it works.
Sage and rosemary from the abbey garden, steeped all night.
The brothers' mead. Everything comes back a little faster after a cup.
